title: LR warmup=0.03 at DEPTH=9
description: Changed WARMUP_RATIO from 0.0 to 0.03 (3% of the 5-min budget ramping LR linearly from 0 to peak), all else at DEPTH=9 baseline unchanged.
reflection: val_bpb 1.000503, worse than the 0.998924 baseline. Warmup does not help at this width/depth -- a brief ramp from 0 costs more in wasted peak-LR time than it saves in early-step stability. Combined with whatever WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 runs land elsewhere this round, this closes out the warmup axis as a dead lever; the group should move to a genuinely new axis next round (e.g. decoupling depth/width via ASPECT_RATIO, or embedding_lr/adam_betas) rather than more schedule tweaks.
